purpose: Holistic implementation scope; not an enabled feature manifest.

tier_definitions.core_build: Proposed first large-build scope, delivered through integration checkpoints. This does not mean already implemented.
tier_definitions.extension: Explicit supported expansion route using shared contracts; each named recipe must be completed before activation.
tier_definitions.needs_named_device_or_provider: Adapter requires a selected device/export/model/provider and its concrete data contract; generic imports can precede live acquisition.

status_note: Current status describes product scope and integration. Separate preparation_evidence records bounded reference probes, model smoke checks or artifacts; these do not enable a capability, qualify a physical device or establish construct validity.

taxonomy.modality: What is recorded, including sensor, response or media streams.
taxonomy.paradigm: What participants do and how stimuli/control conditions are scheduled.
taxonomy.construct: Interpretation supported by a named design/model, not a sensor type or automatic universal score.
